configurePresets.name: vs2026-x64-debug
configurePresets.displayName: Visual Studio 18 2026 x64 Debug (optional, NOT verified on this machine)
configurePresets.description: Optional future path. CMake's own release notes list 'Visual Studio 18 2026' as support added in CMake 4.2 (upstream documentation, see docs/build/bootstrap.md); the CMake bundled with Visual Studio 2022 Professional on this machine is 3.31.6 and does not list that generator, so configuring this preset here fails with 'Could not create named generator Visual Studio 18 2026'. It is kept so a newer CMake needs no repository change. It is not the accepted development path.
